description: Diagnostic tool that queries mcp_signal_scores for all 8 signals and counts distinct score values across the 34 MCP servers in the synthetic corpus. Reports which signals have <20 distinct values (weak discrimination) versus >=20 (acceptable). Output format: {signal_type: distinct_count, verdict: 'WEAK'|'OK', recommended_action: str}. Primary targets: permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety (currently at 3 distinct values each). Uses write_service query only; no DB writes. Returns actionable guidance: either (a) rebuild identified weak enrichments with better logic, (b) add wiring to existing _v2 modules, or (c) investigate integration path. Include human-readable summary print at end.
